ms.promise: Engagement with a reputable Cardano auditing company to do a design review of the contracts, and make sure there are no structural issues. Additionally, a report written by us documenting the design.
ms.criteria: The report from the auditing company details any concerns they have about the core design of the protocol (irrespective of how it's implemented) and outlines constructive next steps for our team to implement.
ms.report:
We are submitting the milestones for this project a bit late, after we have already disclosed our public whitepaper and launched the new contracts on Testnet. The whitepaper should be viewed as a much more high fidelity version of what an earlier-stage Medium blog would have covered. We believe its public release and publicity satisfies the intent of this milestone.

ms.report:
We've authored this Medium post outlining some of the early changes we made in response to TX Pipe's design audit: https://sundaeswap-finance.medium.com/enhancing-sundaeswap-how-we-leveraged-txpipes-audit-insights-for-smarter-contract-design-16c49203f37c
Additionally, you can view the complete changelog for all actions made over the last several months in response to the security audit as we finalized the contracts in preparation for Mainnet launch (Note: the audit is now complete and the contracts are live on Mainnet)
https://github.com/SundaeSwap-finance/sundae-contracts/actions
